ar.tone:
Respectful and neutral, masculine singular second-person
Default: أنت
ar.cta_buttons:
Conversion/promotional CTA: short direct imperative.
EXAMPLE: سجّل الآن
ar.marks: Use the Arabic question mark ؟; otherwise follow standard Arabic punctuation.
ar.quotes: Use double quotation marks " " by default; avoid guillemets « » except in highly formal contexts.
ar.hyphen: Use only in compound words, without spaces.
ar.en_dash: Use for ranges, time spans and sports matchups; spaces on both sides unless character-limited.
ar.em_dash: Use for pauses, explanations or separation of ideas; spaces on both sides.
ar.versus: Prefer a spaced en dash, يواجه, or ضد.
ar.number_sign: It depends on the purpose of the #/Nº symbol
ar.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

az.tone:
Formal and polite by default; informal only in SMM
Default: siz
az.cta_buttons:
Use the polite imperative.
EXAMPLE: Qoşulun
az.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.
az.quotes: Use double quotation marks “ ”; do not use quotes for UI labels.
az.en_dash: Use for ranges and time spans; the source shows spaced use in prose.
az.em_dash: Use for a pause, explanation, continuation or contrast; spaces on both sides.
az.ordinals:
Use numeral + Azerbaijani ordinal suffix -cı/-ci/-cu/-cü.
EXAMPLE: 1-ci
az.versus:
Use an en dash without spaces.
EXAMPLE: Tottenhem–Mançester Yunayted
az.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

bn.tone:
Formal and respectful by default; informal only in SMM
Default: আপনি
bn.cta_buttons:
Use the polite imperative.
EXAMPLE: করুন
bn.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.
bn.period_comma:
- Use danda । instead of the English full stop.
- Use an English full stop after numbers at the end of sentences so '।' is not mistaken for '1'.
bn.quotes: Use double quotation marks for primary quotations; single quotation marks only for nested quotations or highlighted terms.
bn.hyphen: Use in compound words, prefixes and transliterated foreign terms.
bn.en_dash: Use for ranges, durations and connections.
bn.em_dash: Use for pauses, interruptions or emphasis; follow source spacing.
bn.ordinals:
Use Bengali ordinal forms with Arabic numerals.
EXAMPLE: 1ম
bn.versus: Prefer বনাম; when space is limited, use ব or an en dash.
bn.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

de.tone:
Formal and polite, formal second-person
Default: Sie
de.cta_buttons:
Use a direct infinitive.
EXAMPLE: Bestätigen
de.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.
de.capitalization: Capitalize all German nouns and the formal pronoun Sie; other words remain lowercase except at sentence starts.
de.period_comma: No space before; one space after. Use the single ellipsis character (…) rather than three dots. Do not use the Oxford comma.
de.marks: After a colon, semicolon, en dash, or equals sign, use lowercase unless the next word is a noun/proper noun or begins a direct quotation.
de.quotes: Use German double quotation marks „ “; use ‚ ‘ for nested quotations; do not use guillemets.
de.hyphen: Use in compounds and as a minus sign, without spaces.
de.en_dash: Use for ranges and breaks in thought; spaces for breaks, no spaces in ranges.
de.ordinals:
Write ordinals with a full stop after the numeral.
EXAMPLE: 1.
de.versus:
Use an en dash without spaces instead of vs.
EXAMPLE: Tottenham–Manchester United
de.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

el.tone:
Formal and respectful by default; informal only in SMM/casual campaigns
Default: εσείς
el.cta_buttons:
Use the imperative for engagement/promotional CTAs
EXAMPLE: Εγγραφείτε τώρα
el.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.
el.marks: The semicolon (;) functions as the question mark.
el.quotes: Prefer double curly quotation marks “ ”; guillemets « » are acceptable in formal texts; avoid straight quotes.
el.hyphen: Use in compound words and prefixes only.
el.en_dash: Use for ranges and sports matchups, without spaces.
el.em_dash: Use for pauses or emphasis, without spaces.
el.ordinals:
Use gender-specific ordinal suffixes attached directly to the numeral; do not use ordinals in dates.
EXAMPLE: 1ος
el.versus:
Use an en dash without spaces instead of vs.
EXAMPLE: Ολυμπιακός–ΠΑΟΚ
el.number_sign:
It depends on the context:
Νο or Αρ.
el.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

fr.tone:
Formal and polite, second-person plural
Default: vous
fr.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.
fr.marks:
Require a non-breaking space before and one space after.
EXAMPLE: Voici votre bonus : 200 FS gratuits !
fr.quotes:
Default: guillemets (« … ») with non-breaking spaces inside the quotes
EXAMPLE: Il a dit : « Tu vas gagner gros ! »

To fit the charlim: straight quotes ("…") are acceptable.
fr.en_dash: Used to indicate a range or break in thought
fr.em_dash: Used to insert an aside or emphatic break inside a sentence. Mostly replaced in digital French in favor of a comma or parentheses for clarity
fr.ordinals:
Numeral followed by an ordinal indicator
Format Rules:
- masculine singular: use “er” only with “1” (e.g., 1er)
- feminine singular: Use “ère” for “1” (e.g., 1ère)
- plural: “e” for the rest (e.g., 2e, 3e).
fr.versus:
Use lowercase “vs.” with a period
EXAMPLE: Tottenham vs. Manchester United
fr.number_sign: Number is abbreviated as Nº or nº in French.
fr.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

hi.tone:
Respectful and gender-neutral; use formal second-person and neutral/plural rewrite
Default: आप
hi.cta_buttons:
Use the polite imperative.
EXAMPLE: भाग लें
hi.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.
hi.period_comma:
- Use '।' instead of the English full stop
- Use an English full stop after numbers at the end of sentences so '।' is not mistaken for '1'.
hi.marks: Use as in English: semicolon between related clauses, colon before lists/explanations, ? for questions, ! for emphasis or commands.
hi.quotes: Use double quotation marks "…"; use single quotation marks only inside another quotation.
hi.hyphen:
Use for compounds joining equal or related words, without spaces.
EXAMPLE: हँसी-मज़ाक
hi.en_dash: Use for ranges/time spans without spaces; a hyphen is acceptable if an en dash is unavailable.
hi.em_dash: May mark interruption or emphasis; a hyphen is acceptable in ordinary copy.
hi.ordinals:
Ordinals agree with gender/context; above 20 use -वाँ/-वीं.
EXAMPLE: 21वाँ
hi.versus: Prefer बनाम; use an em dash when space is limited.
hi.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

hing.tone:

EXAMPLE: pahla sthan

it.tone:

Use the 2nd-person singular imperative.
EXAMPLE: Partecipa
it.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.
it.quotes: Use double quotation marks " " by default; use single quotation marks only inside another quotation.
it.hyphen: Use for compound words and prefixes.

Use Italian ordinal indicators; avoid English ordinal suffixes.
EXAMPLE: 1°

Use a hyphen without spaces instead of vs.
EXAMPLE: Milan-Inter

Casual / Lists - n. or n.°

Ex.: Gara N. 5

Commercial / Digital - # or No.
Ex.: #1, No. 1

ja.tone:
Polite and context-dependent; omit personal pronouns when possible; use desu/masu forms:
です／ます
ja.cta_buttons:
Use short imperative/plain verb forms or action nouns/katakana without する.
EXAMPLE:
ログイン
確認する

ja.period_comma: Use Japanese period 。 and comma 、, with no spaces.

ja.tilde:
Use Japanese tilde 〜 for all types of ranges.
EXAMPLE: 10:00〜18:00
ja.em_dash: Use the full-width em dash — with no spaces.

Use the prefix 第 before the numeral; do not use English suffixes.
EXAMPLE: 第1

Use 対 instead of vs.
EXAMPLE: PSG対インテル

No. or 第 (before number)
Ex.: 第1

kk.tone:
Formal and respectful by default; informal only in SMM

Use for compound words, ordinal numerals and abbreviations/measurement units with suffixes.
EXAMPLE: 5-тур

Prefer short hyphenated forms; use full ordinal forms only when context requires.
EXAMPLE: 3-орын
kk.versus:
Use an em dash with spaces.
EXAMPLE: Барселона — Челси

ko.tone:
Polite and indirect; omit second-person pronouns when possible; use a member title when direct address is necessary
Default: 회원님

Prefer the nominalized infinitive ~하기; short nouns/stems are allowed when space is tight.
EXAMPLE: 참여하기

ko.tilde:
Use ~ for ranges instead of a hyphen/en dash.
EXAMPLE: 1960~1970

ko.ordinals:
Use Korean ordinal/ranking expressions instead of English suffixes.
EXAMPLE: 1~3위

Use 대 or vs without a period.
EXAMPLE: 맨유 대 첼시
ko.fs_fb: Write FS/FB as 프리스핀 / 프리벳 when space allows; abbreviations are allowed only under strict limits.

ky.tone:

EXAMPLE: 1-орун

EXAMPLE: Барселона–Реал Мадрид

ms.em_dash: Use for a pause/break or explanation; spacing follows the source.

EXAMPLE: Tottenham lwn. Manchester United

mr.tone:

mr.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.
mr.quotes: Use double quotation marks "…"; use single quotation marks only inside another quotation.
mr.hyphen:

pt-pt.tone:
Informal “tu” is the default (product, marketing, CRM, promo). Avoid “você”.
For support/formal/legal, use “o senhor / a senhora” with 3rd-person verbs.
Default: tu
pt-pt.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.

Use angular quotation marks («…»). For nested quotes use double (“…”), then single (‘…’).
EXAMPLE: Disse: «Hoje vais ganhar muito!»

Use without spaces in compounds and as a minus sign.
EXAMPLE: aposta de 3 €; -10 °C

Use for ranges and breaks in thought. Add spaces on both sides for a break; omit spaces in ranges and sports pairings.
EXAMPLE: 5–10 €; Tottenham–Manchester United
pt-pt.em_dash: Do not use in product, marketing, or UI copy.
pt-pt.ordinals:
Write ordinals with the masculine “º” or feminine “ª” superscript, not a bare full stop.
EXAMPLE: 1.º, 2.º, 40.º
pt-pt.versus:
Use an “x” without spaces (though “vs.” is also common).
EXAMPLE: Tottenham x Manchester United
pt-pt.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

EXAMPLE: 6 – 8 seconds

th.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

tr.tone:
Formal and polite; use modern siz forms (-ın/-in/-un/-ün) and avoid stiff -ınız/-iniz-style forms
Default: siz
tr.cta_buttons:
Use the polite imperative.
EXAMPLE: Katılın
tr.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.
tr.capitalization: Capitalize languages, nationalities and religions. Days, months and seasons are lowercase unless sentence-initial.
tr.quotes: Use double quotation marks “ ” in UI/marketing/digital content; do not use quotes for UI labels.
tr.hyphen:
Use a hyphen for ranges, without spaces.
EXAMPLE: Temmuz-Ağustos
tr.en_dash: Do not use for general ranges; prefer a hyphen. Use a spaced en dash in sports pairings.
tr.em_dash: Rare; prefer a comma, parentheses, colon or sentence restructuring.
tr.ordinals:
Use numeral + period + noun.
EXAMPLE: 1. sıra
tr.versus:
Use an en dash with spaces.
EXAMPLE: Tottenham – Manchester United
tr.specific:
Separate suffixes from proper nouns and numerals with an apostrophe.
EXAMPLE: Türkiye'nin
tr.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

uk.tone:
Formal and respectful by default; informal only in SMM. Capitalize Ви/Ваш in direct personal communication
Default: ви / Ви
uk.cta_buttons:
Use the infinitive for buttons.
EXAMPLE: Закрити
uk.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.
uk.period_comma: Do not place periods in headings, titles, button labels, or after грн/UAH.
uk.quotes: Use guillemets « »; use straight quotes " " for nested quotations. Periods go outside the closing quote.
uk.hyphen: Use in compound words, without spaces.
uk.em_dash: Use for pauses, explanations, contrasts and sports versus, with spaces on both sides.
uk.ordinals:
Use hyphenated ordinal indicators -й/-га; do not use English suffixes.
EXAMPLE: 1-й турнір
uk.versus:
Use an em dash with spaces.
EXAMPLE: Динамо — Шахтар
uk.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

ur.cta_buttons:
Use the polite imperative.
EXAMPLE: کلک کریں
ur.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.
ur.quotes: Use double quotation marks " " by default.
ur.en_dash:
Use for ranges without spaces.
EXAMPLE: 9:00–5:00
ur.em_dash: Use for a break in thought, emphasis or parenthetical information, with spaces on both sides.
ur.versus:
Prefer بمقابلہ
Use vs. or an em dash only when character limits require it
ur.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

uz.tone:
Formal and respectful by default; informal only in SMM
Default: Siz
uz.cta_buttons:
Use the infinitive (-sh) or a verbal noun.
EXAMPLE: Ro'yxatdan o'tish
uz.quotes: Use double quotation marks “ ” by default; use single quotation marks only inside another quote; do not quote UI labels.
uz.hyphen:
Use without spaces in compounds, Arabic-numeral ordinals/years and particles; do not add a hyphen after Roman numerals.
EXAMPLE: 1991-yil
uz.en_dash: Use without spaces for ranges; use a spaced en dash in sports/betting matchups.
uz.em_dash: Use for explanations, pauses or emphasis, with spaces on both sides.
uz.ordinals:
Use Uzbek suffixes with Arabic numerals; do not use a hyphen after Roman numerals.
EXAMPLE: 1-o‘rin
uz.versus:
Use a spaced en dash.
EXAMPLE: Real Madrid – Chelsea
uz.specific: Prefer the standard English apostrophe ' for consistency with tags/codes; the curved apostrophe ʻ is also valid.
uz.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

vi.tone:
Neutral and polite; avoid gendered or age-specific forms
Default: bạn
vi.cta_buttons:
Use a concise bare action verb.
EXAMPLE: Đăng ký
vi.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.
vi.quotes: Use double quotation marks “ ” for quotations, titles and highlighted terms; use ‘ ’ for nested quotations.
vi.hyphen:
Use without spaces in compound/transliterated forms and sequential numbers.
EXAMPLE: Cấp độ phụ 1-3
vi.en_dash: Use for ranges and connections, with spaces on both sides.
vi.em_dash:
Use for a pause, break in thought or additional explanation, without spaces.
Where several dashes are used, no spaces around is also possible.
vi.ordinals:
For tournament/prize rankings, use Hạng + Arabic numeral; use an en dash without spaces in ranking ranges.
EXAMPLE: Hạng 1
vi.versus:
Use vs. with a period; a dash may be used in compact UI/headlines.
EXAMPLE: Việt Nam vs. Thái Lan
vi.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.

zh.tone:
Formal and respectful in product/marketing/support; informal only in SMM; omit pronouns when clear
Default: 您
zh.cta_buttons:
Use clear, concise and direct active phrasing.
EXAMPLE: 立即注册
zh.service_buttons: According to CTA buttons or verbal noun.
zh.period_comma: Use full-width Chinese punctuation; use a half-width space between Chinese characters and letters/numbers.
zh.quotes: Use full-width Chinese quotation marks “…”; use ‘…’ for nested quotations; 《》 is reserved for book/game titles.
zh.hyphen: Reserve for compound names, codes or hyphenated terms; do not use for numeric ranges.
zh.tilde:
Use wave dash ～ for time, number, page or date ranges; a full-width en dash is also allowed.
EXAMPLE: 第 8～10 页
zh.en_dash: Not preferred for numeric ranges; use wave dash ～. A full-width en dash may be used as an alternative.
zh.em_dash: Avoid the standard Chinese dash —— on websites; prefer a comma or colon.
zh.ordinals:
Use the prefix 第 before the number.
EXAMPLE: 第 1 页
zh.versus: Replace vs. with Chinese matchup phrasing such as A 与 B 的对比.
zh.number_sign:
No. or 第 (before number)
Ex.: 第1
zh.specific: Use full-width parentheses with Chinese text and half-width parentheses with English/numbers.
zh.fs_fb: Use FS/FB for short versions. Don't use transliteration.
